verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no FIPS 140 validation, no Common Criteria certification, and no documented water or crush resistance for any Feitian FIDO key model. The only certifications mentioned are FIDO2 and Apple MFi, which are compatibility certifications, not security validations for regulated environments.

support.subject: As an IT admin, certified models exist for regulated environments — FIPS 140 validated or Common Criteria certified — with documented durability (water/crush resistance)
